name: lna-linearity
scope: NOMINAL-CORNER nonlinear method qualification and first collection for design/lna_stage1 with IDEAL lossless L/C matching: two-tone IIP3 (spec row 7) and single-tone input P1dB (spec row 8). Rows 7 and 8 keep their ratified targets; a result here is a placeholder-circuit measurement at one corner (hbt_typ, 27 C, 2.5 V), not compliance and not an all-corner statement. The band (row 1) is still a DRAFT.

ports.source: ideal voltage source behind 50 ohm; open-circuit peak Vs per tone; available power per tone = Vs^2/(8*Z0)
ports.load: 50 ohm to ground at the DUT out port; a component of peak V delivers V^2/(2*Z0)
ports.input_axis: per-tone AVAILABLE source power (not absorbed power); the DUT input match is not ideal, so absorbed power differs
ports.gain: transducer gain = delivered load power / available source power

placement_note: Both tones and both IM3 products (2f1-f2, 2f2-f1) lie inside the draft band; the single-tone P1dB frequency is the midpoint of each pair. Tone spacing 100 MHz.

sweep.axis: per-tone available input power (two-tone: each of two equal tones; single-tone: the one tone)
sweep.note: the two-tone sweep stops where the DUT leaves its operating limits plus a margin (IM3 fitting needs the uncompressed region); the single-tone sweep must reach the 1 dB crossing. A tighter solver is used for the two-tone IM3 products (they are 60-100 dB below the carriers) than for the single-tone compression sweep, where a tight solver aborts the transient at high drive (observed in method development).

time.note: window = 2 periods of the 100 MHz spacing; every analysed frequency (tones, IM3 products, floor probes at 50 MHz offsets) is an integer multiple of 1/window = 50 MHz, so the rectangular window is exactly coherent and no window correction applies. FFT bin spacing 50 MHz.

numerics.note: ngspice .options per request. Method-development probes (local, hbt_typ, 19.45 GHz tones) showed the integrator's truncation error creates spurious products AT the IM3 bins that the no-product floor-probe bins do not see (IM3 at -50 dBm per tone moved by ~0.3 dB between reltol 1e-6 and 1e-7/trtol=1, and by up to ~1.7 dB between 1e-5 and 1e-7), so IM3 needs the tight setting and the timestep-halving check is the qualification, not the floor probes alone.

extraction.floor_definition: numerical floor of a run = the larger of the delivered powers at two coherent bins that carry no tone, harmonic or intermodulation product (2f1-f2 minus 50 MHz, 2f2-f1 plus 50 MHz; single tone: f0 -/+ 50 MHz)

operating_limits.source: spec row 17 (no npn13G2 above 1.4 V V_CE; model card vce window 0.4-2.0 V) and the model-card V_BE box 0.65-0.96 V used by sim/lna-sparam-nf/stage1_tables.py
operating_limits.applied_to: instantaneous peak/minimum over the retained window for Q1 and Q2 of V_CE and V_BE (as version 1), plus the signed maximum/minimum of the collector terminal current of each device (collector_current below)
operating_limits.rule: a sweep point that breaks a voltage limit, or an ENFORCED current bound, or that lacks finite current diagnostics, is classified 'outside DUT operating limits' and is excluded from fits and baselines; it is never fitted through

collector_current.quantity: ngspice instance parameter @q.<instance>[ic] of the inner VBIC BJT of npn13G2 (Qnpn13G2): the simulator's own instantaneous collector terminal current, read after .tran/linearize on the retained window; no element is added to the circuit (non-perturbing by construction, checked by sim/lna-linearity/tests/test_current_instrumentation.py)
collector_current.sign: positive = conventional current INTO the collector terminal of the npn (forward active conduction is positive)
collector_current.normalization: frac = I_C / (box_a_per_nx * Nx), the same Ic/(3 mA x Nx) convention as sim/lna-sparam-nf/stage1_tables.py; Nx is the DUT netlist instance parameter (checked against design/netlist/lna_stage1.spice by a test)
collector_current.published: per base sweep and per device: signed maximum and minimum (A and fraction of box) with the input power at which each occurs, the number of points over the box, and whether the envelope is complete
collector_current.interpretation: The model-card header states 'ic: <(0.003*Nx) A' as part of the VALID RANGE of the VBIC extraction, whose measurement ranges are DC Gummel/output sweeps. It is a quasi-static (DC conduction) range. Nothing in the card says it bounds the instantaneous terminal current of a transient, which also carries displacement (junction/diffusion charge) current at 18-21 GHz. Whether the bound applies to that quantity is NOT established, so it is NOT promoted to an instantaneous safety rating.
collector_current.policy: applicability unresolved: collector-current extrema are published and flagged 'unresolved' (complete_envelope = false, no claim that the operating box is fully covered); points over the box are listed but are not excluded on that basis. Missing, incomplete or non-finite current diagnostics are ALWAYS a rejection (cannot pass silently). Setting enforce = true in a later plan version, with a decision record establishing applicability, routes violating points through the same rejection as the voltage limits (baselines and both estimators).

convergence.note: variants: base; half_step (solver max step and DFT grid halved, same window); double_window (same step, retained window doubled, same discard). A refined variant must reproduce the baseline estimator outcome within the tolerances; a failure is published as 'unconverged' and the number is not a result.

controls.description: memoryless cubic y = a1 x + a3 x^3 between the same 50 ohm terminations (closed forms in linearity.cubic_expectations): run through the identical generated ngspice block and extractor as the DUT

targets.source: spec/target-spec.md rows 7 and 8 (ratified, input-referred); unchanged by this plan

dut_expected_corner_note: hbt_typ, 27 C, 2.5 V only. Corner dependence is a later campaign.
development_note: Numerics, sweep ranges and the IM3 floor margin were fixed after ~10 local single-unit ngspice debug probes at the mid placement (run before this plan was committed); the limits, targets, tolerances of the closed-form controls and the convergence tolerances were not tuned on DUT results. The plan is committed before the collection and the record cites its commit. Version 2 adds only the collector-current diagnostics (issue #121); the instrumentation was qualified on a closed-form fixture and a with/without non-perturbation comparison before this declaration was committed; no DUT sweep was run.
supersedes_interpretation: plan.json (plan_version 1, voltage-only operating limits) stays frozen and keeps its exact semantics for the committed record 20261010-174208-0f67eaf; this file is the next-campaign declaration and changes ONLY the operating-limit diagnostics (adds per-device collector-current monitoring). Sweep, time grid, numerics, extraction thresholds, controls and the ratified targets are byte-for-byte those of version 1.
